native_route_limitations.current_native_contract: Successful native Enchanted Pocket Watch time-freeze changes an allowed creature from unfrozen to frozen after all native guards. Preserve blacklist, cooldown and durations. The Dragonfin Boots extra-jump alternative is client-only in this installed version and does not qualify.

OR native equipped Tusklin controlled movement >=5blocks, tame Cosmaw native rescue returns actor safely, Spectre native lead tow moves actor >=5blocks, native Orca swimming buff applied to actor, controlled native Endergrade steering with ChorusOnStick travels >=5blocks, OR actual equipped RoadrunnerBoots sprinting on supported sand for40ticks with native sand-speed branch active. WarpedToad has no native riding/controller path and does not qualify. Preserve native safety and actual own native success.

native_route_limitations.unavailable_alternative: Kimono clearing an already acquired undead target
native_route_limitations.current_native_contract: Distinct2 native successes among the five supported routes: RockyChestplate ram positive hostile damage while rolling, TendonWhip chain hits2distincthostiles, SkelewagSword native parry blocks projectile/attack, CentipedeLeggings native climb elevates actor>=3blocks along wall, or native EmuLeggings evade/cancel an actual incoming projectile. Kimono cancels new target acquisition but does not clear an existing undead target, so its original target-clear alternative is unavailable and gives no credit. No item-owned or generic hit. Each distinct result counted once.

Actual native AutoHealSkill commits resource payment and effective positive healing with net health gain for the same real actor. Canceled or clamped healing and unpaid or passive ownership do not count. BloodIntoMana substitutes health for a mana debit in this installed version, does not increase mana, and its original mana-gain alternative is unavailable.

The native Infested, Ooze or Weave owner creates actual accepted silverfish, slime or cobweb output on an eligible mob, causally attributed to the real player applied effect. Mere potion use or command effects do not count. Installed Winded has no native wind-cloud spawn, so its cloud alternative is unavailable. Preserve all native rules and reject canceled or preview outcomes.

Native configured iron repair consumes actual iron and increases genuinely missing wagon durability for the real actor. Installed wool recoloring consumes no input, so it cannot meet the original paid recoloring alternative and does not count. Raw item interaction is insufficient.

Real actor loots native whaleborne Widget from shipwreck_supply loot, native installation commits it to actor-used Hullback, then native cannon consumes gunpowder and fires actual projectile OR anchor changes deployed state through authenticated Helm control. The installed buried-treasure Widget modifier is absent and does not provide an eligible acquisition route. No inventory-only module proof.

Native Demolition Leap or compatible Meteor Slam reaches committed post-success movement or attack outcome for a real logical-server actor, with original native requirements and costs. Phantom Ascent has no authoritative native server execution receipt in this installed version and does not qualify. Reject canceled, preview, client-animation and raw-click proof.
